scope: Complete overlapping exact-hit recovery, GENCODE header identity/biotype, design/stratum reconciliation, pinned release116 comparison; no whole-paper review.
verdict: no blocking defect identified in inspected code

checks.finding: positions advances by start+1, preserving overlapping windows; per-target hit iteration includes terminal starts and multiple occurrences in one transcript. Full recovery retains up to a deliberate10000-hit fail-fast scope cap, not a silent20-hit witness truncation. Shared target sequences fan out to all design IDs. Record boundaries are separate.

Eight positional fields match inspected official GENCODE50 README receipt. Versioned transcript/gene IDs are retained; field8 is explicitly transcript biotype. Declared length and unique full transcript ID are enforced. Gene symbol, not gene ID, determines the same declared parent-gene stratum.

Counts compare every expected parent/other pair including expectedzero; nearest-gene sets compare for positive strata. Recovered and saved coordinate identities must be unique; every saved tuple must exist, with gene/window equality and exact metric/value. Saved128-row pinned witness schema independently inspected: it has start_0based and window_5to3, no end-coordinate field. New end is derived as start+16.

Pinned release receipt and60-ID snapshot hashes checked before use. Snapshot key/returned stable ID must agree; transcript version, gene stable ID, biotype and length disagreements are exposed separately. Absent snapshot IDs receive not_in_pinned_release116_snapshot; version match is labelled comparison rather than universal annotation agreement. No live current-release equivalence is asserted.

executed_validation: Read source and tests, parsed test AST, hashed current files; did not execute tests, recovery, scientific corpus or external packages.
untested_limits: No actual134-occurrence recovery or six-new-occurrence result is established by this review; those remain cloud acceptance assertions.
No whole-record GENCODE header compatibility or duplicate-ID absence verified here; code fails closed on unexpected headers.

PAR_Y/legacy R-prefixed IDs, missing optional snapshot length, deadline, output-path and input-hash failure paths are not covered by inspected synthetic tests. PAR_Y version strings may compare as mismatches rather than normalized equivalence; no evidence this affects the19-design hit set.
The19 accepted exact-positive designs are the entire recovery scope, not an independent rediscovery of all targets or negative strata outside that selection.
Release116 snapshot covers only60 previously captured transcript IDs. Newly encountered IDs cannot receive release116 annotations from this utility.
Pinned source hashes protect provenance but are not semantic validation of original accepted nearest-count fields; separate independent exact-census evidence supplies that context.
